claims: The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) is closed on Friday, April 3, 2026, in observance of Good Friday.
There will be no trading activity on the U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) on April 3, 2026.
The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) will reopen on Monday, April 6, 2026.
Bond markets are closed on April 3, 2026.
The London Stock Exchange is closed on April 3, 2026.
The Hong Kong Stock Exchange is closed on April 3, 2026.
The next market holiday is Memorial Day on Monday, May 25, 2026.
